questions.question: What does JVM stand for?
questions.explanation: The JVM executes Java bytecode on any platform.

questions.question: What does JDK stand for?
questions.explanation: The JDK bundles the compiler, tools, and the JRE for developers.

questions.question: What does JRE stand for?
questions.explanation: The JRE provides the JVM and libraries needed to run Java programs.

questions.question: Which Java keyword declares a class?
questions.explanation: Classes are introduced with the class keyword.

questions.question: What is the name of the JDK command that compiles Java source files?
What is the name of the method the JVM calls to start a Java application?
questions.explanation: Execution begins in the static main method.

questions.question: Which Java keyword makes a class inherit from a superclass?
Which Java keyword declares that a class conforms to an interface?
questions.explanation: implements commits the class to the interface's methods.

questions.question: Which Java primitive type stores true or false values?
questions.explanation: boolean is the primitive type for logical values.

questions.question: What file extension do compiled Java classes have?
Which Java keyword instantiates a new object?
questions.explanation: new calls a constructor and allocates the object.

questions.question: Which package is automatically imported into every Java program?
questions.explanation: java.lang is implicitly imported and contains String and Object.

questions.question: Which Java keyword declares a constant that cannot be reassigned?
questions.explanation: final variables are assigned once and never change.

questions.question: Which Java primitive type is a 64-bit signed integer?
Which access modifier makes a member visible from any other class?
questions.explanation: public is the least restrictive access level.
